name: Continental Gangsters
description: Continental Gangsters is a faction of the Imperial Spanish Gangsters Nation (Imperial Gangsters Nation) based on the North Side of Chicago, Illinois. The section was originated by a member known as 'the Minister' and formed as the Imperial Gangsters Nation expanded, alongside other sections including the Ghetto Gangsters and the Imperial Spanish Gangsters on North & Hamlin.
